summary: Iteration 183 - CRED-style Step-based Login Flow Tests - ALL PASSED. Backend APIs (/auth/start, /auth/verify-login-otp, /auth/mpin-login, /auth/mpin-setup-login) working correctly. Frontend Login.js shows step-based flow: enter email → OTP verification → MPIN (if set). All UI elements verified with proper data-testid attributes.
critical_code_review_comments: Login flow uses separate collection 'login_otp_tokens' - good isolation from signup and forgot-password OTP
Rate limiting: 5 OTP requests per hour per email, 30s cooldown between requests
OTP expiry: 5 minutes, max 3 attempts per OTP
temp_token (JWT) created after OTP verification - valid for 10 minutes
MPIN must be exactly 4 digits - validated on backend
If user has no MPIN and no biometric, they are auto-logged in after OTP verification
Password fallback uses existing /api/auth/login endpoint - still works
Google login redirects to OAuth - unchanged
Frontend step state machine: enter → otp → mpin_setup | mpin → success
